context: Yumiko and Sho tidy a desk together.
purpose: Casual home register; vocabulary (ノート/鏡/開く/撮っ/箱) in natural home.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: この箱に、ノートをしまいましょう。
lines.en: Let's put the notebooks in this box.
lines.style: gentle mother voice, soft warm caring delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: このノート、開くと絵がいっぱい!
lines.en: When I open this notebook, it's full of drawings!
lines.style: excited small child voice, bright warm bouncing delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: あら、上手ね。写真に撮っておこうか。
lines.en: Oh, well done. Shall we take a photo?
lines.style: warm mother voice, soft warm delighted delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 鏡の前で、撮ってもいい?
lines.en: Can we take it in front of the mirror?
lines.style: eager small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: いいわよ。鏡を、きれいに拭くわね。
lines.en: Sure. I'll wipe the mirror clean.
lines.style: gentle mother voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 箱を開くと、昔のノートもあった!
lines.en: When I open the box, there are old notebooks too!
lines.style: surprised small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 懐かしいわね。写真に撮っておきましょう。
lines.style: tender mother voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ノートを開くの、楽しいね!
lines.style: happy small child voice, bright warm cheerful closing delivery throughout
